name: Pi.dev Review: Hands-On Look at the Pi Coding Agent - Petronella Cybersecurity News
description: Pi is an open-source, terminal-based AI coding agent that you run locally on your own machine, connect to any of 15-plus model providers, and extend with TypeScript code. There is no SaaS account, no dashboard, no workspace in the cloud.
